images.name: bola_vertical
images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one landscape 3:2 illustration for a Brazilian high-school mathematics worksheet. Detailed realistic black pen-and-ink textbook engraving style, fine varied contours and sparse controlled cross-hatching, pure white background, strictly black and white, no colors or gray wash. Clear readable shapes at small print size, tasteful detailed textures, ample white negative space, all main objects fully within frame. No text, letters, numbers, equations, axes, dimension marks, logos or watermark. An adult athlete on a flat training ground in full-body view, seen from a moderate distance, has just tossed one ball vertically upward with one hand. Show exactly ONE ball high above the outstretched hand, on the SAME vertical line. Add a fine straight vertical dashed motion path between hand and ball, NOT a parabolic spatial arc: this is a vertical launch. Realistic relaxed throwing follow-through, simple sports clothing, shoes, subtle grass and minimal distant trees. Clear visible ground line under athlete. Do not show ghost balls or a second ball. Wide scene with substantial sky and player smaller in lower left-center.

A park entrance consisting of a freestanding thick masonry arch, shown almost straight-on so the opening is easy to interpret geometrically. The INNER opening is a smooth inverted-U parabolic curve meeting the flat ground at two distinct feet, with NO vertical pillars extending the opening below the curve. Symmetric arch rises from ground, gently rounded apex, no pointed or gothic apex. Carefully detailed stone blocks around the curved arch, subtle depth, a walking path passing through the opening into a sparsely drawn garden with low bushes and a few distant trees. Main arch clearly outlined, no gates or people obscuring the two ground contact points. No trajectory line and no annotations.
images.revision_prompt: Edit this black-and-white stone park arch illustration. Crucial geometric correction: REMOVE the straight vertical pillars and their horizontal capitals entirely. The INNER edge of the entrance must be ONE continuous smooth inverted parabola from its left ground contact to the apex to its right ground contact. At both feet it must slope inward as it rises, never have vertical straight segments. Think an inverted parabola cutout, NOT a semicircle on columns. Keep the detailed stone voussoirs following this parabolic opening all the way down to ground, the white sky, fine ink hatching and garden path. Entire arch fits frame. No text, measurements or axes. Preserve detailed monochrome educational illustration style.
